name: 1-on-foot-downtown.png
description: Rhea 'Rook' Solano on foot on a rich Downtown stone pavement, tall architectural glass towers rising into a warm gradient sunset sky with drifting clouds, procedural asphalt and paver detail, newspaper vending boxes, pedestrians, and long cast shadows across the avenue.

name: 2-car-drive-promenade.png
description: Custom sports car at speed along the coastal Ocean Promenade, low golden sun disc and solar corona over moving dual-harmonic ocean waves, wet asphalt reflections, palms, boardwalk railing, and the marina in frame.

name: 3-police-pursuit-stars.png
description: Police chase at its height: four wanted stars on the HUD, red and blue emergency strobes flashing across surrounding buildings, player vehicle flanked between two push-bar cruisers on a wide boulevard with the Elevated Skyway Overpass towering behind.

name: 4-mission-dock-showdown.png
description: Climactic showdown at Meridian Docks: corrugated multi-colored shipping container stacks, 38-meter gantry crane, syndicate operatives, police helicopter casting a volumetric searchlight beam, and open bay water beyond.
